name: 一页介绍网页（agent 示例）
description: 让 agent 先写大纲、再做一个单文件网页，最后用脚本检查网页。演示 agent 和 script 两种执行器，默认用 Claude Code。 / Have an agent outline a topic, build a single-file web page from it, then check the page with a script. Shows the agent and script executors; uses Claude Code by default.

topic.description: 网页介绍的主题，例如：为什么猫喜欢纸箱 / What the page explains, e.g. why cats love boxes

audience.description: 读者是谁 / Who the page is for
audience.default: 对这个主题好奇的普通读者

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English。决定大纲、网页和检查结果的语言 / Output language: zh or en. Sets the language of the outline, the page and the check report

stages.name: 大纲
stages.description: agent 根据主题写网页大纲：标题、副标题和几个小节。 / The agent writes the page outline: title, subtitle and a few sections.

stages.name: 网页
stages.description: agent 照大纲做一个单文件网页，不引用任何外部资源。 / The agent builds a single-file web page from the outline, with no external resources.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 脚本检查网页：有标题、语言对、没有外部资源、大小合理。不通过就失败，回到上一步重跑。 / A script checks the page: it has a title, the right language, no external resources and a sane size. It fails otherwise, so you re-run the page stage.
